system.description: When your mind would be negatively affected by an effect of level 4 or less (psychic commands, illness, fear, boredom, mind control, and so on), you can ignore the effect. If the effect lasts for a while (such as fear or mind control), it has no power over you until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. If the effect is instantaneous (such as a psychic blast that inflicts damage), it doesn't affect you at all. Effort: Increase the maximum effect level you can ignore by 1. Enabler.
